valuation.method: Forward diluted EPS x P/E. EPS is the 12 months of operating income after Oct-2027 viewed at the 12-month target date (about FY2027), built as operating income x (1 - tax rate) / diluted shares; non-operating items (Anthropic mark-ups, which inflated GAAP EPS in Q2 2026 and Q3 2025) are excluded and interest assumed to net to zero. Diluted shares about 10.95B (Q3 2026 net income $20.7B / EPS $1.89). Anchors: Q3 2026 operating income $28.1B (13.9% margin), Q4 2026 guide $28.5-33.5B, 2026 capex about $220B with meaningfully more in 2027, management view of AWS growth above 40% in 2027 and 2028. Model assumptions, not company guidance.

bear.driver: AWS growth fades toward 25-30% while depreciation from the capex ramp compresses margin; operating income about $110B for the year
bear.assumption: Operating income $110B, tax 18%, 11.0B shares: EPS $8.20 at 24x

base.driver: Q4 2026 guide midpoint (about $31B) annualizes to about $124B, plus roughly 9% growth as AWS grows near 40% and retail margin holds; operating income about $135B
base.assumption: Operating income $135B, tax 17%, 10.95B shares: EPS $10.23 at 28x

bull.driver: AWS sustains 40%+ growth with operating leverage and advertising keeps growing in the high teens; operating income about $160B
bull.assumption: Operating income $160B, tax 17%, 10.9B shares: EPS $12.18 at 30x

valuation.implied_by_close: At base EPS $10.23 the $266.66 close implies 26.1x; the simple-average analyst target of $340 (four named calls) implies 33.2x at base EPS, or EPS about $12.14 at 28x (about 19% above the model)
valuation.sensitivity: One turn of P/E moves the base target by $10.23 (3.8 pp of the close); $10B of operating income moves base EPS by about $0.76 and the target by about $21
valuation.watch_metric: AWS segment growth (39% in Q3 2026) and AWS operating margin (17.8B on 46.0B, about 38.7%), against capex and free cash flow (trailing-twelve-month free cash flow was an outflow of $42.4B)
valuation.next_disclosure: Q4 2026 results, expected late January / early February 2027 (date not yet confirmed)

analyst_notes: Four named analysts found (UBS, Morgan Stanley, BofA, TD Cowen), all Buy-equivalent; three updated after the Oct 29 release, with TD Cowen and BofA trimming targets slightly while UBS raised, and Morgan Stanley's raise to $350 predates earnings. Their $317-352 targets sit about 19% to 32% above the close; against the base case this gap equals roughly 2 EPS dollars at 28x or about 5 extra P/E turns at base EPS. Published consensus (about $332 across 60 analysts, S&P Global via Stocktwits) is similar, but the named sample is small and no 12-month horizon was documented, so these calls are excluded from the weighted target.
